LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: Peccatulum (ZAYIN)
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: Distorted entities born from unstable Cogito injections—Gluttony, Lust, Melancholy, Pride, Sloth, and Wrath. Each ZAYIN-class Peccatulum embodies a distinct sin, four-color combat affinity, and lethal breach reflex when left uncontained.
